prompt: Some people believe that advertising does a great job of persuading people to buy things. Others think that advertising has become so common that people no longer even notice it. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is argued that the public is often swayed by good advertising campaigns, while others do not consider them as a tool of consumer manipulation. Regardless of these two points of view, I firmly believe that marketing is AN essential part of brand or product awAreness, and that society is exposed to advertisements, even if they do not realise it. This essay will examine both opinions in detail and state my viewpoint.

On the one hand, in our modern world, urban residents are bombarded with advertisements everywhere; there are banners and flyers in the strees, pop-up  and pay-per-click ads on the Internet. Moreover, a product’s catchy slogan might capture attention and manipulate the consumer’s choices. For instance, a crucial number of businesses try cold-calling every day to sell their services or products, and customers are often influenced by such telemarketing.

On the other hand, advertisements might not resonate with the target audience. Commercials seem intrusive, and people avoid them, relying on word-of-mouth marketing and friend’s reccomendations. As a result, when companies flood inboxes with a significant number of emails, it  just pushes the audience further away from their product; someone finds such a case unethical. This means that the population turn away from ads because they do not trust or enjoy them.

Personally, I am convinced  that a large part of our society gets on the bandwagon and is affected by advertising. One of the principal reasons is the effective use of subliminal messages by shops that target our subconscious. For instance, corporations invest money every year in analysing their target audience and applying psychological tools to attract customers; moreover, advertisers can track what online users search for on the Internet and offer tailored ads. Another factor is that certain categories of the community are influenced by trends and celebrity endorsements. For example, a well-known Russian shoes brand “Ekonika” made an advertising campaign with Rosie Huntington for their Autumn 2026 collection, and the pumps were sold out by females during the week after launching the commercials.

In conclusion, the modern world is affected by advertisements due to the power of subliminal messages and the influence of trends.
